Where Verkflo sits in your AML operations

Verkflo does not replace your screening provider, your transaction monitoring system or your case management tool. Those systems keep generating the hits and alerts and holding the cases. Verkflo runs the procedure your analysts follow when an alert lands: it collects the customer profile, the transaction history and the list entry, applies your disposition rules and puts a recommendation in front of an analyst.

Screening runs through ComplyAdvantage today. A monitoring or fraud system connects through Custom REST when it exposes an API, so the agent can read the alert and the account history it needs.

Onboarding checks that feed your AML program are on KYC automation and KYB automation.

Who does what in AML operations

  • The procedure

    Your AML procedures set how a sanctions hit is cleared, which monitoring alerts can be closed with a standard rationale, what a fraud analyst checks first and when a case goes to your MLRO or compliance officer.

  • What the agent does

    • Screens names for sanctions, PEP and adverse media in ComplyAdvantage

    • Fetches the listed entry behind each screening hit

    • Gathers the customer profile and transaction history for a monitoring alert

    • Applies your disposition rules and drafts the case note

  • What your team decides

    • Whether a screening hit is a true match

    • Closure of any monitoring alert, including ones the agent recommends closing

    • Holds, blocks and other account actions on a fraud alert

    • Which cases go forward for a reporting decision

AML procedures you can run today

Open one to see example runs, the rules behind them and where a reviewer steps in.

  • +1↗ Sanctions screeningScreen counterparties before the first payment and send each possible match to a person.
  • +1↗ Transaction monitoring alert triageGather the alert, customer profile and history, apply your disposition rules and route what needs a person.
  • +1↗ Fraud alert triageCollect the device, account and transaction context for each fraud alert and put a decision in front of an analyst.
  • +1↗ PEP and adverse media reviewCompare each PEP or adverse media hit with the customer file and put the evidence in front of a reviewer.

Closing an alert stays with an analyst

For monitoring alerts, the agent can recommend closure where your rules allow it, for example alert.rule in low_risk_rules && customer.risk_rating == "Low". The recommendation waits in the review queue until an analyst confirms or overrides it.

The analyst's name, the rule that fired and the evidence the agent gathered are logged together with the run. The ComplyAdvantage integration page lists the screening calls.

AML automation questions

Does Verkflo replace our transaction monitoring system?

No. Your monitoring system keeps generating alerts. Verkflo runs the triage procedure on each alert it receives and hands the case to an analyst with the context gathered.

Can the agent close an alert by itself?

Closure stays with an analyst. The agent can recommend it where your rules allow, and the recommendation waits in the review queue until a person confirms or overrides it.

Which screening provider does it work with?

ComplyAdvantage today. A provider with an API can be added through Custom REST.

How do we test a procedure change before it reaches live alerts?

Publish the new version to the sandbox and run your eval scenarios, such as a true match and a near miss. A failing scenario blocks publishing.

Bring an alert you worked last week

We'll run it through your triage procedure as an agent and show the case note an analyst would review.
